rubric.0: Major semantic error/omission or unintelligible output
rubric.1: Partly correct: meaning largely recoverable but grammar, aspect, nuance, terminology or idiom defect
rubric.2: Meaning preserved with acceptable fluency; paraphrases accepted

reviewer: AI qualitative bilingual review; illustrative corpus, not blinded human study or standardized metric
